mechanism: Ceftazidime may reduce gut flora diversity, potentially increasing loperamide absorption and systemic exposure, while loperamide can decrease antibiotic efficacy by reducing GI transit and local drug concentration.
action: Monitor for loperamide toxicity signs (CNS effects, abdominal distension); consider alternative antidiarrheals if diarrhea is infection-related; ensure adequate loperamide dosing interval separation is maintained.
